tagline.en: MIT-licensed Latent Action Pretraining — a 7B model that learns actions from video without action labels.
tagline.zh: MIT 许可的 Latent Action Pretraining(潜在动作预训练)——一个从视频中学习动作、无需动作标注的 7B 模型。

en: LAPA (Latent Action Pretraining) is an approach for learning robot actions from video by discovering a latent action space, rather than relying on labeled action data. The released LAPA-7B-openx model applies this to the Open X-Embodiment data and is available under an MIT license.

It is a visual-action model: it consumes visual context and produces actions as latent action tokens, distinct from a video-generation model even though it draws on video. The 7B checkpoint is published on Hugging Face.
In WorldFoundry you run LAPA to derive action tokens from visual input. The 7B weights are staged as action-token model assets and pulled in at run time.
zh: LAPA(Latent Action Pretraining,潜在动作预训练)是一种从视频中学习机器人动作的方法:它通过发现一个潜在动作空间来学习,而不依赖带标注的动作数据。已发布的 LAPA-7B-openx 将该方法应用于 Open X-Embodiment 数据,以 MIT 许可提供。
它是一个视觉-动作模型:摄入视觉上下文,以潜在动作 token 的形式输出动作——尽管借助视频,但它区别于视频生成模型。7B checkpoint 已发布于 Hugging Face。
在 WorldFoundry 中,你运行 LAPA 从视觉输入推导动作 token。7B 权重以动作 token 模型素材的形式备好,在运行时载入。

whenToUse.en: Use it when you want a latent-action pretraining approach that learns actions from video without action labels, and outputs latent action tokens from visual context.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想要一种潜在动作预训练方法——从视频中无标注地学习动作,并从视觉上下文输出潜在动作 token 时,选它。

notFor.en: It is an action-token model, not a video generator, so don't expect rendered video output. The 7B checkpoint downloads separately, so plan for the download and disk space.
notFor.zh: 它是动作 token 模型而非视频生成器,不要期待渲染出的视频输出。7B checkpoint 需单独下载,请预留下载时间与磁盘空间。

en: Learns actions from video without action labels
Latent-action pretraining on Open X-Embodiment data
Outputs latent action tokens from visual context
